title: Label tree in the right-hand scene menu
description: 'View/edit labels in a tree structure on the right hand menu so that I can click a label and highlight all of the patches that have that label.' SceneModelMenu builds the ESC panel as a HyperString each frame with clickable words (MODELS, Recompute, CONTROLS). Add a LABELS section (a sibling section class, not more code in SceneModelMenu) that renders the PatchLabels hierarchy as an indented, collapsible tree: click a label -> highlight every patch carrying it (directly or via descendants) with one colour per label; click the picked patch's entry -> expand its labels; counts per label. Rename, delete and re-parent go through terminal commands (`relabel a b`, `reparent a p`) since the panel is click-only. Keep drawing allocation-light (cache the tree HyperString and rebuild only when labels or selection change). VIEW-3 (tag tree panel in mesh viewer, in progress) is the panel this extends from per-vertex tags to PatchLabels; build on it, do not add a second tree.
definition-of-done: 1. LABELS section shows the hierarchy with expand/collapse and per-label patch counts. 2. Clicking a label highlights all its patches; clicking again clears. 3. relabel/reparent/unlabel commands update the tree immediately and persist via save-layout. 4. Tree HyperString is rebuilt only on change (verified by a counter in a headless test or log). 5. Screenshot in the ticket shows the tree and a highlighted label. 6. Build checkstyle-green.
testing-plan: 1. run-scene patch-label --keep-alive; `ixdar-cli key ESCAPE`; screenshot; `ixdar-cli click` on a label row; `ui-state` reports highlighted label and patch count. 2. `type 'reparent thumb hand'`; screenshot shows the moved node. 3. Unit test of the tree flattening (labels -> ordered rows with depth) on a hand-built PatchLabels.
